cues: Once again only the phenoxide ion is activated enough.
The carbene attacks the ortho position, and after hydrolysis and acidification, the C C l two group becomes an aldehyde: salicylaldehyde, two hydroxybenzaldehyde.
Use carbon tetrachloride instead, and you get salicylic acid.
